item.title: Mask My File — Black out data before sharing | iOS App
item.description:
Share safely without losing the context people genuinely need. Mask My File finds private details before you send a file, permanently hides only what you choose, then reopens and verifies the new copy before it shows Private Ready. WHAT YOU CAN DO • Images and PDFs: full-width preview, up to 5× zoom, smooth drag, and precise manual selections. • Visual files: permanent solid redaction or removal only. Face and barcode detection simply mark regions for you to review. • Text, JSON, XML, HTML, CSV, TSV and RTF: search every match, then apply a full mask, a partial mask, a placeholder, a pseudonym, or removal. • Remove metadata where the format allows. Work page by page in PDFs, or protect up to 100 files at once with individual previews, cross-file search, and per-file manual selections. • Keep everything organised with Private Session, project workspaces and Placeholder Vault. USE IT WHEN IT MATTERS Before you send a tenancy application, an NHS letter, a payslip showing your National Insurance number, or a client file to a colleague, keep the useful context while permanently hiding the details they do not need. PRIVATE BY DESIGN Everything is processed on your device. There is no account, advertising, tracking, analytics or content upload. Apple Vision and the embedded Tesseract OCR engine run locally. Face detection creates regions only: it does not identify a person, build a template, share face data or retain it. Apple handles purchases with StoreKit. Mask My File does not use a VPN, NetworkExtension, proxy, tunnel, DNS filter or network routing. Originals are never overwritten; temporary workspace files, Private Session data and projects stay on the device until you delete them. BUY ONCE. USE IT FOR LIFE. A single purchase unlocks unlimited verified outputs and batch processing for good. No subscriptions. Restore your purchase at any time through the App Store.

item.title: Wordmate Lite: Vocabulary — Five new words in a minute | iOS App
item.description:
Five words, one minute, and a path you can see behind you. Most vocabulary tools want you to build decks first and revise forever afterwards. Wordmate Lite turns that around. You open it, walk a five word pebble trail, and you are finished for the day. The closing screen shows the exact five words you have just learnt, so the minute is never wasted. It suits adults who have started a language three or four times and let it slide: commuters on the train, anyone revising for an exam, people brushing up before a holiday, professionals who need the vocabulary of their own trade, and anyone who wants a run of days they can keep even when they are shattered. There are 44 languages to learn and 14 everyday paths, among them travel, business, exams, daily life, dining, shopping, interviews, health, technology, nature, entertainment and social chat, each organised into small units at beginner, intermediate and advanced level. Tap a word to hear it spoken by the system voice, and choose which voice reads each language. Save the words worth keeping, sorted by topic and level, and go back to them whenever you like. Set a daily goal of 5, 10, 15 or 20 words, then watch it build: how many days in a row you have kept going, your best run, today's total, progress in each language and a small ring filling on every topic and unit. It all works offline. No account, no sign in, no personal data collected, no third party advertising and nothing tracked. Whatever you learn stays on your own device, on the Tube, on a delayed train, or anywhere with no signal at all. You can start without paying: one learning language and one path at beginner level stay open for good, and every other path stays visible so you can see what is waiting.
